description.zh: 网关集群所在的地域。可通过DescribeRegions接口获得有效的regionId。
description.en: The region where the gateway cluster is located. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to obtain a valid region ID.

description.zh: 网关集群描述。长度限制0~128个字符。
description.en: The description of the gateway cluster. The description can be 0 to 128 characters in length.

description.zh: 网关集群名。长度限制1~60个字符，可以包含大小写字母，中文，数字，“.”，“_”或“-”，同时必须以大小写字母或者中文开头。
description.en: The name of the gateway cluster. The name must be 1 to 60 characters in length and can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, Chinese characters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), or hyphens (-). The name must start with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, or a Chinese character.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sgw create-storage-bundle --name alex-123000 --description For_testing --backend-bucket-region-id cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
